title: High vacuum dual thruster spinner test, about 2.5 millinewtons

tellings.quote: What we have here is a vacuum test highlighting actual movement in vacuum using a dual thruster pack in the vertical spinner orientation.

plain: A pair of small thrusters mounted on a vertical spinner moved on their own inside a high vacuum chamber in Florida, pushing with a force of about 2.5 millinewtons, a very small but measurable push. Charles Buhler, a NASA engineer who ran the work, shows Michels the video and says it proves 'actual movement in vacuum'. If true, it would mean a drive that pushes without throwing anything out the back, which is how he frames it as antigravity propulsion.
